User reported: comments don't show inline. Root-caused 4 bugs in feedback.js: (1) loadComments runs before async IIFE renders page content, (2) normalized-fallback returned indexes into normalized text used as positions in original, (3) FYI grey-on-grey is invisible on .active anchor, (4) click handler doesn't preventDefault inside wrapped anchors.

Fixes: (a) listen for dashboard:rendered event to re-walk DOM after page renders, (b) rewrite locateQuote with whitespace-flexible regex (positions stay in original text), (c) saturated 4-tier highlight colors (indigo FYI, accent blue Fix, red Block, amber Override) + #N marker badge after each anchor, (d) preventDefault on .fb-anchor clicks, (e) unanchored-comment banner for quotes that can't be located
All 5 pages now dispatch dashboard:rendered after page.innerHTML so the overlay re-walks the populated DOM
